name: Erriapus

attributes.attribute: linked by the Romans to Mercury

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Erriapus was a Celtic god of the Continent and Britain. Gaulish inscriptions record this god's worship. The Romans equated him with Mercury, their god of commerce. In England, horned gods such as Cernunnos connect to this obscure figure. His cult was thin and his story lean. Only scattered stone and place records carry his memory.
